The handwriting was careful and slanted: 'If you are reading this, the tide has been kind to me, and I hope it finds you well.' There was no name, only a date from nearly sixty years earlier and a small drawing of two boats side by side. That evening he wrote a reply, sealed it in a bottle, and threw it into the dark water, hoping someone, somewhere, would answer.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台慢慢降温的机器。路灯还亮着，街道空得能听见自己的脚步声。便利店的白光落在湿漉漉的柏油路上，偶尔有外卖骑手呼啸而过，车灯划破寂静又很快消失。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几扇还亮着，不知是加班的人，还是失眠的人。远处的早点摊已经升起热气，蒸笼掀开的一瞬间，白雾缭绕。环卫工人推着车缓缓前行，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。天边还没有光，但城市已经在悄悄准备醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion means a function calls itself.\n- Each call works on a smaller piece of the problem.\n- It stops when it reaches a simple case you can answer right away."}
